exp1.purpose: actuator saturation temporal association and full contact-pair diagnostic; no causal module labels; no inferential primary contrast

exp2.purpose: direction option only; fixed baseline versus closest-pair normal

exp3.purpose: final substep guard only; F full, B all final guards disabled

smoke.admission: technical finite/schema/control and metric identity only; never task outcome

allocation.gpu_rule: (rep + 3*scene_index) % 6; scene_index 0 main, 1 pillar_x_plus40mm; same-seed configs always same GPU
allocation.configuration_order: rotate list by seed % number_of_configurations; reversal not selected by outcomes
allocation.initial_state_first_observation_first_ac: audit and retain equality/differences; do not replace required unpaired tests with paired tests

metrics.STSR: SR and no true pillar contact, tool-floor event or recorded pillar tilt; only these3events
metrics.PCR: at least one recorded robot/tool pillar contact; exclude pillar-table support
metrics.J: sum external robot+tool per-contact3D force norms at completed1ms steps times0.001; exclude protected-internal grip
metrics.J4: same integral over first4000valid contiguous1ms physical steps after episode start; requires full4s; absent if early termination; no zero fill or extrapolation
metrics.Fpk: maximum external per-contact norm sum over completed episode
metrics.tau_limit: six arm actuators actual actuator_force at compiled lower/upper force range tolerance1e-8, not ctrl or residual torque
metrics.continuous_summary: episode mean±sample SD; report available n separately for J4
metrics.proportion_uncertainty: Wilson95%, z=1.959963984540054; episode is statistical unit

families.test: two-sided Mann-Whitney U, asymptotic tie and continuity correction
effects: mean difference F-B as descriptive only

missing_testing: If outcome has no valid observations/test impossible, p=null and family remains plannedm with missing p conservatively1 for Holm; no declaration that incomplete planned cohort confirms superiority. Formal planned N and observed coverage always shown.

failure_categories.technical: policy_error/simulation_error/perception_error/infrastructure exception are retained technical attempts, endpoint unknown, not task failure by default; exact same allocation seed/GPU/config may be restored once without outcome-based retry; all attempts retained
failure_categories.stage: trace observable phase_pre codes0..3 and raw predicates, not exact task truth; final guard post-pickup-before-first-valid-placement is interval-start predicate, not post-outcome phase selection

saturation_analysis.unit: each completed substep and six actuator indices
saturation_analysis.first_limit: first completed saturation interval; firstphase uses phase_pre with phase_metric_valid_pre retained
saturation_analysis.dominance: at each saturated joint compare abs(delta_geometry),abs(delta_contact_clipped),abs(delta_guard); unique max only, ties/zero separate; report coincident jump and position error; association NOT causal attribution
saturation_analysis.contact: all ragged contacts present; maximum contributor at Fsumpeak from protected-external contact force norms; retain internal grip separately
saturation_analysis.demand: demand_exceeds only if supported actuator model; clipped output at limit does not itself establish excess unbounded demand

figures.selection: exp1/main minimum planned seed810000, configurations raw,G,F, first technical-valid completion of that exact allocation; no selection by force/task effects; if not available report missing rather than choose favorable alternative
panels: six actual torque traces with limit±lines
position error if space; saturation intervals marked

jump_limiter_optional.status: optional diagnostic only, not primary experiment4
jump_limiter_optional.calibration: ONLY all10exp1raw allocations across2scenes; completed steps with previous_applied_valid and finite nonzero absolute target jump; per joint pooled99percentile, numpy percentile methodlinear
jump_limiter_optional.freeze: write threshold vector with all raw source hashes and counts before any limiter run; no tuning by F outcomes
jump_limiter_optional.comparison: same exp1F allocations/seeds/GPU; report all5, preserve task and contact costs; matched inference equality audit; descriptive only

stopping: No success-rate based stop, no favorable sample selection. All planned failures retained. Technical issue stops infrastructure until recorded and fixed; retain incomplete attempt and uncertainty.
partial_reporting: Write actual completed/technical/missing counts. Do not run confirmatory family interpretations until full planned allocations fixed; repeated interim p-value inspection is not a stopping rule.

extra_layouts.reason: optional layout extension not scheduled; no silent scope expansion

software: Python numpy/scipy/matplotlib versions and script/source hashes recorded in output
